name: Kiss

whyMatters.en: New York makeup hard-rock/metal: Rock and Roll All Nite (1975) as chant anthem, Alive! as live-document sales model; I Was Made for Lovin' You (1979) adds disco-tempo crossover without dropping the brand spectacle.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约化妆 hard-rock/metal：Rock and Roll All Nite（1975）作口号颂歌，Alive! 作现场文献销量模型；I Was Made for Lovin' You（1979）加 disco 速度跨界，不丢品牌视觉秀。

essentialTracks.title: I Was Made for Lovin' You

lyricQuotes: I wanna rock and roll all night / And party every day
I was made for lovin' you baby / You were made for lovin' me

shortBio.en: NY makeup hard-rock/metal; Rock and Roll All Nite chant, Alive! live model, Lovin' You disco-tempo hit.
shortBio.zh: 纽约化妆 hard-rock/metal；Rock and Roll All Nite 口号、Alive! 现场模型、Lovin' You disco 速度热单。

body.en:
Formed 1973 from Wicked Lester remnants (Stanley/Simmons) with Frehley and Criss. Dressed To Kill and Alive! (1975) sell three-chord hard-rock plus pyrotechnic stage craft—Rock and Roll All Nite is the chant template. Destroyer (1976, Bob Ezrin) adds Detroit Rock City and Beth ballad.

Dynasty (1979) pushes I Was Made for Lovin' You: four-on-the-floor tempo, Vinnie Vincent-era later changes aside, classic four faces remain the brand ID. Makeup-off 1980s Lick It Up era still rides the same riff/chant grammar.
body.zh:
1973 年由 Wicked Lester 残余（Stanley/Simmons）加 Frehley、Criss 组建。Dressed To Kill 与 Alive!（1975）卖三和弦 hard-rock 加烟火舞台——Rock and Roll All Nite 是口号模板。Destroyer（1976，Bob Ezrin）加入 Detroit Rock City 与 Beth 谣曲。

Dynasty（1979）推出 I Was Made for Lovin' You：四拍底鼓速度；后期阵容变化另论，经典四张脸仍是品牌 ID。80 年代卸妆 Lick It Up 期仍骑同一 riff/口号语法。

scenes.track: I Was Made for Lovin' You

note.en: Disco four-on-floor tempo + Kiss brand vocal; Dynasty crossover.
note.zh: Disco 四拍底鼓速度 + Kiss 品牌人声；Dynasty 跨界。

title.zh: 视觉秀作为 hard-rock 产品

body.en:
Kiss treat makeup, boots, and pyro as equal to the riff. Songwriting stays three-chord hard-rock/early metal with Stanley/Simmons hooks.

Alive! proves the live album can outsell studio polish for this brand.

I Was Made for Lovin' You shows chart tempo flexibility without dropping the faces.
body.zh:
Kiss 把化妆、厚底靴与烟火当作与 riff 同级产品。写作保持三和弦 hard-rock/早期金属 + Stanley/Simmons 钩子。

Alive! 证明对这品牌而言，现场专辑可压过录音室抛光。

I Was Made for Lovin' You 显示榜单速度弹性，不丢脸谱。

body.en:
Stanley, Simmons, Frehley, Criss define 1973–1980 peak. Criss exits; Frehley exits early 80s; Vinnie Vincent and others rotate.

1996 reunion restores classic makeup four for tours.

Brand continuity outranks any single guitarist era.
body.zh:
Stanley、Simmons、Frehley、Criss 定义 1973–1980 巅峰。Criss 离队；Frehley 80 年代初离队；Vinnie Vincent 等轮换。

1996 重聚恢复经典化妆四人巡演。

品牌连续性强过任何单一吉他手时期。

title.zh: 体育场口号与 glam-metal 债务

body.en:
80s glam/hard-rock acts copy the merchandise-plus-riff model. Metallica and others cite early Kiss as entry hard-rock/metal.

Rock and Roll All Nite remains a chant-structure teaching track.

Influence is showcraft and simplicity, not progressive technique.
body.zh:
80 年代 glam/hard-rock 乐队复制周边+riff 模型。Metallica 等引早期 Kiss 作入门 hard-rock/metal。

Rock and Roll All Nite 仍是口号结构教材曲。

影响在秀与简洁，非 progressive 技术。

interviewQuotes.text: Alive! is when people understood Kiss. The studio records were the blueprint; the stage was the product.
